name: The Arcane Protocol
description:
## Lore

The Arcane Server guards a sealed door deep within the Obsidian Citadel. It speaks a language no adventurer has heard — a binary tongue of keys and echoes, always beginning with a whisper and ending with a seal.

Many have tried to speak to it, but none have answered correctly.

## Your Task

Connect to the Arcane Server. It will send you a nonce. Study the server source code to understand the protocol, compute the correct response, and send it back to receive the flag.

## Flag Format

The flag is in the format: `FantasyCTF{...}`

hints.content: The server always sends something first. Listen before speaking.
The server's seal is keyed. Check the server binary for the key.
Compute HMAC-SHA256 of the nonce using the hardcoded key. Send the hex digest.
